title: 同轴电缆：由 L_0、C_0 求特性阻抗、相速和波长
statement: 一段 l = 5 m 的同轴电缆可以看成无损耗线（R_0 = 0、G_0 = 0），单位长度电感 L_0 = 0.25 µH/m、电容 C_0 = 100 pF/m。信号源 U̇_s = 2∠0° V（有效值），内阻 R_s = 50 Ω，频率 f = 10 MHz，终端接 R_L = 50 Ω。
x 从始端（1–1′）量起；图中线旁的数据只是长度，L_0、C_0 见题干。

questions.ask: 终端电压 U̇_2 的初相 = ?（U̇_s 初相为 0°）
questions.explain: R_s = R_L = Z_c：始端 U̇_1 = U̇_s/2 = 1∠0° V，线上只有入射波；βl = 0.1π × 5 = π/2，所以 U̇_2 = 1∠−90° V——这段线正好是 λ/4。

questions.ask: 频率升高到 20 MHz（电缆不变），下面哪个量不变？
choiceExplain: λ = v/f 变成 10 m，β = 2π/λ 加倍。
βl 变成 π，U̇_2 的初相变成 −180°。
questions.explain: 无损耗线的 Z_c = √(L_0/C_0)、v = 1/√(L_0C_0) 只由原参数决定，与频率无关；λ 减半，β、βl 加倍。

hints: 无损耗线的副参数只由 L_0、C_0 决定：Z_0 = jωL_0，Y_0 = jωC_0。
R_L = Z_c 时线上只有入射波，U̇(x) = U̇_1·e^{−jβx}；U̇_1 由 R_s 与输入阻抗分压得到。

en.title: Coaxial cable: characteristic impedance, phase velocity and wavelength from L_0 and C_0
statement: A coaxial cable of length l = 5 m may be treated as lossless (R_0 = 0, G_0 = 0), with inductance L_0 = 0.25 µH/m and capacitance C_0 = 100 pF/m per unit length. The source is U̇_s = 2∠0° V (rms) with internal resistance R_s = 50 Ω at f = 10 MHz, and the end is loaded with R_L = 50 Ω.
x is measured from the start (1–1′); the drawing shows only the length, L_0 and C_0 are given here.

questions.explain: v = 1/√(L_0C_0) = 1/√(2.5×10⁻¹⁷) = 2×10⁸ m/s, about 2/3 of the speed of light, independent of frequency.

questions.ask: Initial phase of the end voltage U̇_2 = ? (U̇_s has phase 0°)
questions.explain: R_s = R_L = Z_c: U̇_1 = U̇_s/2 = 1∠0° V and only the incident wave exists; βl = 0.1π × 5 = π/2, so U̇_2 = 1∠−90° V — the cable is exactly λ/4 long.

questions.ask: The frequency is raised to 20 MHz (same cable). Which stays the same?
choices: the phase of the end voltage
questions.explain: For a lossless line Z_c = √(L_0/C_0) and v = 1/√(L_0C_0) depend only on the primary parameters, not on frequency; λ halves while β and βl double.
choiceExplain: Right: both contain only L_0 and C_0.
λ = v/f becomes 10 m and β = 2π/λ doubles.
βl becomes π, so U̇_2 gets the phase −180°.

hints: The secondary parameters of a lossless line depend only on L_0 and C_0: Z_0 = jωL_0, Y_0 = jωC_0.
Put R_0 = G_0 = 0 into Z_c = √(Z_0/Y_0) and γ = √(Z_0Y_0); then λ = 2π/β and v = ω/β.
With R_L = Z_c only the incident wave exists, U̇(x) = U̇_1·e^{−jβx}; U̇_1 follows from the divider R_s – input impedance.
solution: **2. Propagation constant.** γ = √(jωL_0·jωC_0) = jω√(L_0C_0): α = 0, β = ω√(L_0C_0) = 2π × 10⁷ × 5×10⁻⁹ = **0.314 rad/m**.
**3. Phase velocity and wavelength.** v = ω/β = 1/√(L_0C_0) = **2×10⁸ m/s**, λ = v/f = **20 m**, so l = λ/4.
